Watch this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 to catch up on the latest Unreal Engine virtual production updates. You’ll get a preview of what’s coming up next for visualization, live compositing, in-camera vfx, post-production, and everything in between from Lead Technical Product Manager Ryan Mayeda in this sneak peek into the roadmap for Unreal Engine 5.8 and beyond.

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 for a look at the powerful new features in the Procedural Vegetation Editor (PVE) in Unreal Engine 5.8.

We demonstrate the ability to grow trees from scratch directly in Unreal Engine, showcasing the botanical simulation hybrid system that enabled the Megaplant team to craft hyper-realistic vegetation. 

We also cover how to leverage the tools to quickly set up and create additional variations of fully Nanite-compatible vegetation assets. We introduce you to the new skeletal extraction tool that can transform your existing trees into fully fledged PVE assets, and for those new to PVE, we touch on features you might have missed from our first release.

Find out more about using Unreal Engine to develop games here: unrealengine.com/uses/games

#ProceduralVegetationEditor, #3DTrees, #Megaplants, #UE 5.8, #UnrealEngine, #UnrealFestChicago2026
title: Growing Trees in Unreal Engine: PVE 5.8 New Features and Roadmap | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
In-island transactions add a new revenue stream on top of engagement payouts—and pricing your offers well is a design practice, not a one-time decision. In this livestream, we walk through frameworks for setting prices and packaging items across your catalog: a three-tier price structure (entry, mid, and premium), different pricing logic for durables vs. consumables, and when bundling serves your players better than individual offers.

A bundle creation example from this stream is available in the Verse Code Snippet Repository on the Epic Developer Community—explore, reuse, and build on it in your own UEFN projects. https://dev.epicgames.com/community/fortnite/snippets

Learn more about pricing and packaging your in-island transactions: https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/fortnite/pricing-and-packaging-your-in-island-transactions-in-fortnite 

Learn more about getting started with in-island transactions:  https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/fortnite/in-island-transactions-in-f
title: Pricing and Packaging your In-Island Transactions | Creating in Fortnite
